title: Aureline M5 supported-line truth feed
description: Canonical per-domain truth-feed record minted by the truth-feed and audience-packet lane over the frozen M5 supported-line-transparency matrix. Bundles one export-safe supported-line truth feed per active stable or LTS-candidate line — the current public-proof-ledger state, migration-scoreboard posture, transparency snapshot, correction-history summary, claim-history summary, and release-evidence links — with stable IDs and freshness dates, so partner reviews, procurement checks, support escalations, and OSS stewardship all inherit one current feed rather than re-synthesizing product truth by hand. Each feed section names its typed kind — a public-proof summary, a migration-scoreboard summary, a transparency snapshot, a correction-history summary, a claim-history summary, or a release-evidence link — its export class (public-safe versus internal-only), and the exact build / release-line identity it is joined to, and links out to compatibility reports, known limits, migration guides, and release evidence rather than duplicating or mutating their content. Public-safe correction-history and claim-history summaries are separated from internal-only incident / security payloads; public-safe and internal-only sections share one canonical line identity so they never diverge, and no section stays green on stale external proof. Raw secret values, private endpoints, and privileged incident / security internals never cross this boundary.
